Context only, stage s6: for season-finals winner contracts (KXATPFINALS, KXWTAFINALS) listed before the field is set, the remaining calendar-year Race decides who is in the field, so it enters as field-formation context and in the schedule/motivation coverage. The Finals-qualification series KXATPFINALSQUAL and KXWTAFINALSQUAL are NOT filed here (series_assignment files them under season_ranking_and_majors, where the race mechanism is owned); this archetype does not price them.
The live series KXATPNEXTGEN (Next Gen Finals) uses a shortened format that needs a different match and round-robin map than the standard model; without this input the series has no format coding.
